item.title: Blue Origin lands New Glenn rocket booster on second try
item.description:
📝 Thursday’s launch wasn’t just about the landing attempt, though. co/TTshvx2GNY— Gwynne Shotwell (@Gwynne_Shotwell) November 13, 2025 New Glenn’s first launch was in January, and Blue Origin experienced a number of delays in getting the second rocket to launch. Blue Origin will now have to demonstrate the ability to refurbish the rocket booster and launch it again.
🔗 Read more: https://techcrunch.com/2025/11/13/blue-origin-lands-new-glenn-rocket-booster-on-second-try/
